title: Write an opinion piece
description: Argue a position with pros, cons, and a persuasive conclusion.

items.prompt: Write 5–7 sentences weighing the pros and cons of hybrid work, then give your view.
items.promptIt: Scrivi 5–7 frasi sui pro e contro del lavoro ibrido, poi dai la tua opinione.

items.prompt: Write two diplomatic sentences suggesting a change at work.
items.promptIt: Scrivi due frasi diplomatiche per suggerire un cambiamento al lavoro.
